name: Adrian Younge
sources: Medium/Cuepoint — Meet the soulful composer who loves being sampled (https://medium.com/cuepoint/meet-the-soulful-composer-who-loves-being-sampled-58e0f5ca1b6e)
NPR First Listen — The Delfonics / Adrian Younge (https://www.npr.org/2013/03/04/172983631/first-listen-the-delfonics-adrian-younge-presents-the-delfonics)
notes: LA's analog absolutist, and the entry says the method is the parameter: "**he composes and records music designed to be sampled**, tracked to tape with vintage kits, tight damping, and a dry close-mic'd sound. Kick on 1 and the offbeat of 2, snare cracked on 2&4, tambourine and bongo overlay, no 16th hat carpet. Because the source is his own new recording rather than an old record, the sample is harmonically complete." So `secondaryAnchor` is 2&, the velocity tiers are hard and tight, the hat is an 8th at a fill density of 0.16, and the percussion is tambourine, bongo and conga rather than a shaker bed. Harmony is "1970s soul-cinema — minor-mode with m9/m11 and half-diminished colour, chromatic descending bass lines, and Italian-library/blaxploitation-score cadences; he writes for strings and horns rather than looping", which is the raised `susOrDimProb` for the half-diminished colour, a chromatic passing-tone set on the bass and a harmonic rhythm that actually moves. The melody is instrumental by design: "melodies are instrumental themes with a vocal only on top", drawn from "a one-man orchestra of Rhodes, Clavinet, vibraphone, harpsichord, sitar, fuzz guitar, flute, string quartet and horn section" — hence the harpsichord timbre hint and a dense sustain-pad-and-answer counter for the strings and horns. Bass is "played electric bass with flatwounds, muted and short, moving in melodic 8ths; no 808". The arrangement is "cinematic — 8-bar thematic statements, instrumental interludes, dialogue/skit segues". ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are all drum probabilities and velocity tiers and every melody figure; the research sources the analog method, studio, label and credits but marks the specific drum values as inferred.
